Content: We have recently moved and need a new door number. Previously, I bought this product for around $22. This time, I chose this cheap one, which is amazing. It is not inferior to expensive products at all. The stainless steel material is very good, and it will not rust or fade. I will feel at ease in any weather. The size is very good, and it is very suitable for viewing from a distance. I don't want to miss any packages anymore. This is what we need, and it is easy to install,
Don’t recommend mixing and matching numbers- this is nice quality and looks easy to install.

This house number appears to be made out of a decent piece of metal -- it's relatively heavy and strong, it certainly isn't going to easily break or bend. It also arrives with the necessary screws and spaces for hanging it up, and since it uses a very simple design for hanging (just two screw holes straight through the metal) and comes with a lifesize template/drawing on the instructions for aligning the screws on the wall -- well, it's very very easy to install.
